subject: SOC2 Type II documents and short bridge letter — Pulse Health procurement
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@pulsehealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, Procurement <procurement@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the conversation earlier — Pulse Health is progressing our security review and procurement needs a couple of items to move the contract forward:

- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood (we require the report covering the controls period).
- If you don’t have the current period report completed, can you provide an interim bridge letter confirming the effective controls for the audit period and an estimated delivery timeline for the full Type II report?
- Clarify the audit period covered (start/end dates) for the report or bridge letter. Our compliance team needs dates to map to our vendor matrix.

We’re aiming to finalize PO by 2027-08-24; any chance you can provide an interim artifact this week?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Vendor Risk
Pulse Health

Attachments: N/A
From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-19T09:35:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Team — Elena from Pulse Health just asked for our Type II and/or a bridge letter with audit period dates. They want something this week to hit PO timelines (2027-08-24). Can we fast-track?

Asks:
- Mina: can security produce an interim bridge letter and confirm the audit period dates we can commit to?
- Vivek: quick confirmation that there are no open remediation items that would block a bridge attestation covering the 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31 period (this is the typical reporting window we used last cycle).
- Marissa: FYI — this is at legal/procurement sprint velocity; recommend we hold a 15-min sync if needed.

I’ve attached the SOC2 summary we share publicly (SOC2_TypeII_2026-summary.pdf). Will coordinate the DocuSign if we produce a bridge.

Prio: high — external deadline is 2027-08-24.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2026-summary.pdf (public summary)
From: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-19T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Thanks — I can produce a short-form bridge letter that summarizes our controls, scope, and the audit period. Draft plan:

- Proposed bridge wording: confirm no material changes to control environment since the last SOC 2 Type II period and that the current Type II report is in progress with our auditor.
- Proposed audit period we can attest to (pending final auditor date): 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31.
- I’ll attach a template (bridge_template_v2.docx) and highlight the few legal approvals needed (security attestation, CFO sign-off optional).

Vivek — please confirm there are no outstanding infra remediation items that would prevent us from attesting to the 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31 period. If anything material, call it out here.

I will turn a draft in by EOD 2027-08-19. If legal needs to redline, we’ll keep the initial draft intentionally narrow.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge_template_v2.docx
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-19T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Confirmed — security has no open critical remediation tickets that would affect the 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31 attestation window. There are two low-priority backlog items (INF-1023, INF-1054) unrelated to access controls covered by SOC.

You have my sign-off to proceed with a narrow bridge letter that confirms:
- audit period 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31
- no material control changes affecting SOC scope since that period

If legal requests deeper detail, I can pull the relevant change-control logs and provide a short summary.

— Vivek
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: N/A
From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pulsehealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-19T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Elena — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can support Pulse Health on the procurement timeline.

What we’re providing now (attached):
- Interim bridge letter (short-form) confirming control posture and audit period 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31. (See attached bridge_template_v2.docx — signed copy will be sent via DocuSign once you confirm acceptance of narrow wording.)
- Public SOC2 summary (SOC2_TypeII_2026-summary.pdf) for your internal review.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you accept an interim bridge letter in lieu of the final Type II report for PO purposes.
2) If yes, we’ll send a DocuSign with the bridge letter today (target turnaround < 24 hours).
3) We anticipate delivering the finalized SOC 2 Type II report by 2027-09-15 once the auditor completes the wrap.

If you need alternate audit dates or a different scope, let me know immediately and I’ll loop legal.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge_template_v2.docx, SOC2_TypeII_2026-summary.pdf
From: Elena Morales <elena@pulsehealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, Procurement <procurement@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + audit period clarification for Redwood

Priyom / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the bridge draft. Procurement confirms we can accept an interim bridge to proceed with PO, provided:

- The bridge explicitly states the audit period (2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31) and that there are no material control changes.
- We receive the signed DocuSign within 24 hours.

Please send the DocuSign link and include any relevant contact for invoice routing. Our procurement timeline: PO by 2027-08-24, invoice processing starts after signed bridge.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the DocuSign.

Best,
Elena
Head of Vendor Risk
Pulse Health

Attachments: N/A
